visualCharacteristics.purpose: Contained rotating promo with image left and heading, text and CTA right
visualCharacteristics.description: Solid dark wellness-blue (#00365b-ish) band with padding. Rotating promo (2 slides): image left (~40%), white H3 + paragraph + white outlined button right. Arrow/pause/dot controls centered below.

contentPattern.structure: 2 columns, one row per slide: cell 1 = image, cell 2 = heading, paragraph, CTA link

usage: Place in a section styled `dark-blue` (section metadata). Image ~40% left on desktop, stacked on mobile. Autoplays with prev/pause/next and dot controls below.
reuseGuidance: Use for mid-page rotating promos with a contained image. For text-only messages use `carousel-callout`; for full-bleed page-top imagery use `carousel-hero`.
